name: Banana Boat Sport Performance SPF 50 Lotion — 240ml
short: Banana Boat Sport Performance SPF 50 Lotion — 240ml — Over-the-counter. Trusted bilingual delivery throughout Cabo San Lucas and San José del Cabo, 24/7.
description:
Banana Boat Sport Performance SPF 50 Lotion — 240ml provides broad-spectrum sun protection for use during outdoor activities along the Los Cabos coast. Sourced from authorized distributors and stored in shaded climate-controlled conditions at our facility.

Typical use involves applying generously 15 minutes before sun exposure and reapplying every 2 hours, after swimming, or after towel-drying. Pair with hats, sunglasses, and shaded breaks during peak UV hours.

Beach-ready delivery available 24/7 across Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the resort corridor.
